name: funcytown-railway-style
description: Opinionated best practices for writing resilient FuncyTown railway-style Result pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: Write fluent typed Result pipelines with FuncyTown.
interface.longDescription: A skill-only plugin for agents writing consumer C# code with FuncyTown. It teaches generated Result aliases, typed error unions, railway-oriented fluent chains, async orchestration, validation, recovery, observability taps, combinators, and endpoint termination.
defaultPrompt: Use FuncyTown railway style in this C# workflow.
Refactor this code into a typed Result pipeline.
Review this FuncyTown pipeline for best practices.
